chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Abi Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Mihran, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Abi Jamilah, from Sa'd al-Iskaf, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام gave judgment regarding a slave-girl who rode upon another slave-girl, then another slave-girl poked her, so the one being ridden jolted and threw down the rider, and she died. So he ruled that her blood money be divided into two halves between the one who poked and the one who was poked.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam Ali عليه السلام as the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.فَصَرَعَتِ: she knocked down or threw down
key_terms.قَضَى: gave judgment; issued a legal ruling

ai.seo_question: How did Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام rule when multiple parties shared responsibility for an accidental death?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام in a case of shared causation in wrongful death. The liability for the diyah is divided equally between the direct instigator and the person whose involuntary movement led to the fatal fall, showing principles of judicial apportionment in jinayat.
